column1: # Spanish verbs — authoring source for the core-es pack.
# Verb forms are NOT authored here: they are generated by src/languages/es/conjugation.ts.
# Put `-` in the id column for a verb that should not get its own card: the
# lexeme, its gloss and all its generated forms still ship. No row uses it yet —
# every verb has an example sentence, and auxiliaries get a card like the rest.
# Leave the id off a new row — omit the column entirely, do not leave it empty:
# a leading tab shifts every field one place. The build assigns one, writes it
# row keeps it thereafter however the file is edited or reordered.
# regularity is cross-checked against src/languages/es/irregulars.ts by the build.
# doler and encantar are named by the gustar-type pattern in build-dataset.ts,
# so leaving them out made that pattern reachable by gustar alone.
